output_list.reason: The contract does not properly check if the account is frozen before transferring tokens, allowing an attacker to transfer tokens from a frozen account.

Similar to the transfer function, the contract does not properly check if the account is frozen before transferring tokens from another account, allowing an attacker to transfer tokens from a frozen account.
The mintToken function allows the owner to mint new tokens without any restrictions, which can lead to token devaluation if misused.
The burn function allows the owner to burn tokens, which can devalue the token as it reduces the total supply.
The setPrices function allows the owner to set prices for buying and selling tokens, which can lead to manipulation of token values if not carefully managed.
